verses.1: The words of Jeremiah, son of Hilkiyah, among the priests who were in exile in the land of Benyamin.
verses.2: It was a command from Jehovah to him during the time of Josiah, son of Amon, king of Judah. This happened during his reign, which lasted for thirteen years.
verses.3: In the days of Jehoiakim, son of Josiah, king of Judah, there were twelve years during which righteousness reigned under him. This lasted until the time when Jerusalem was captured in the fifth month.
verses.4: And the word of Jehovah came to me, saying:
verses.5: Before you are taken away from your body, I will know you. Before you leave this world, I will make you a prophet for the nations.
verses.6: And he said, “Oh, Lord Jehovah! Look, I didn’t know what to say, since I was just a young boy.”
verses.7: And the LORD said to me, “Do not say, ‘I am a young man.’ For you shall go and speak to all those whom I send you.”
verses.8: Do not be afraid of them, for I will save you. May the LORD say so.
verses.9: And Jehovah sent His hand and touched it. Then He said, “Elohim, see, I have given my words to you.”
verses.10: See, today you have been given the authority to rule over nations and kings. You can destroy them, take their possessions, and kill their people.
verses.11: And the Lord said to me, “What do you see, Jeremias?” And I replied, “I see suffering.”
verses.12: And the LORD said to me, “You have done well to consider doing this. I will take action regarding what you have proposed.”
verses.13: And the word of Jehovah came to me a second time, saying, “What do you see?” I replied, “My Lord, I see that your face is like that of a gazelle.”
verses.14: And the LORD said to me, “Be careful! Evil will be brought upon all those who dwell on this earth.”
verses.15: For I say that all the tribes of the kings of Assyria will be brought under God’s rule. They will come and give each one a throne, and they will open the gates of Jerusalem and all its cities around it, and all the cities of Judah.
verses.16: And I have spoken about their judgments regarding all their evil deeds. They abandoned me and worshiped other gods instead. They acted according to their own desires.
verses.17: And you shall keep your vows and stand up, and say to them all that I command you not to do before them. Then they will be holy before you.
verses.18: And today, I have appointed you to rule over a city made of iron and bronze. You will also fight against the enemies who are spreading their influence throughout the land. You will be the rulers of Judah’s people, its priests, and its people.
verses.19: And they will fight against you, but they will not be able to defeat you. For I am the LORD who will save you.
